descriptions: The information or request provided by the user.
Collects user input and displays the application interface.

Checks whether the incoming data is valid and complete.
Transforms input data into the format required by the model.
Processes the prepared features to generate an output.
The result produced by the trained AI model.
The processed prediction returned and presented to the user.
